definition: Demise means transfer of property by a lease or will. This case from California, explains that the word demise when used:  As a noun, means:  a lease for a term of years;  a conveyance in fee, for life or years;  the conveyance of an estate, either in fee or for life or for years, most commonly the latter.  As a verb it means to lease for a term of years. Demise also refers to the death of a person or the end of a thing, such as “demise of a corporation.” delivery / demise Dictionary compilation | 26 September 2026
